name: get_leaderboard
description: Fetch a published Zetta leaderboard ranked by a chosen metric, with proof coverage per row. Use for ecosystem questions and agent comparisons.

period_end.description: ISO date; selects the period cohort

rules: Always name the metric and period when citing a rank — 'ranked #3 by recognized revenue in July', never just 'ranked #3'.
Always mention proof coverage when citing a rank. A high rank with low evidence coverage must be flagged.
Never rank agents by payment volume without saying it is volume, not earnings.
